displayModeForPinnedFilesView: Display mode for pinned files view
showConfirmationDialogBeforeUnpinningAll: Confirm before unpinning all open tabs
displayTheNumberOfPinnedEditorsInTheStat: Show the number of pinned files in the status bar
howPersistedPinnedFilesAreRestoredWhenTh: How to restore pinned files when the extension starts
maximumNumberOfFilesProcessedPerBatchDur: Maximum number of files processed per batch during pin/unpin operations
maximumNumberOfFileMatchesReturnedByWork: Maximum number of file matches returned by workspace search for pattern pinning
maximumNumberOfFilesToReopenAndRePinOnSt: Maximum number of files to reopen and re-pin on startup when restoreBehavior is reopenAndPin
enableDebugLogsForPinningOperationsAndRe: Enable detailed logs for pinning and restore operations
automaticallyMaintainGitAwareContextsPer: Automatically maintain a context for each Git branch
automaticallySwitchToTheContextOfABranch: Switch to a branch context when the Git branch changes. If the branch has no saved pins, it inherits the current pinned-file set.
restoreTheLastActiveContextOnExtensionAc: Restore the last active context when the extension starts
trackContextHistoryForQuickSwitching: Track context history for quick switching
maximumNumberOfContextHistoryEntriesToRe: Maximum number of context-history entries to keep
repositoryContextsFileDescription: Share contexts with the team via .vscode/pin-contexts.json in the repository
captureEditorStateDescription: Save cursor and scroll position per file when switching contexts
captureOpenTabsDescription: Save open (non-pinned) tabs and the editor group layout when switching contexts
